title: RPM Tab
description: RPM Tab documentation for Practice Admin.
overview: This guide covers rpm tab workflows for Practice Admin.

subtasks.title: Review the practice RPM profile
subtasks.purpose: Confirm RPM contact, program window and monitoring flags in one place.

steps.title: Verify RPM Program Dates
steps.description: Verify the RPM row in Program Dates matches the current billing window (Start date, End date, Days).

steps.title: Read Monitoring Details
steps.description: Read Monitoring Details to confirm whether eVitals is monitoring patients and whether devices are being purchased. Notes The RPM tab mirrors the Practice tab but restricts Program Dates to the RPM program only — useful for RPM-only sign-offs. Task 7.9 — Schedule & Targets Tab
